name: Jack in the Box
source:
"At midnight tonight, I shall take the bequeathed treasure of Yoshimitsu Kaid*u."

The letter arrived to the Kaid*u mansion in the remote mountain woodlands, a declaration by someone who called himself the Masked Thief B.
Young master Jin invited detective Daiki onto the case.......
